name: Clement
title: Paul's fellow worker
summary: Clement was one of Paul's fellow workers mentioned in the letter to the Philippians. He worked alongside Paul in the service of the gospel and is counted among those whose names are written in the book of life. Tradition often identifies him with Clement of Rome, one of the early church fathers.

keyEvents.title: Fellow worker in the gospel
keyEvents.description: Clement is mentioned as one of Paul's faithful fellow workers who struggled alongside him for the gospel in Philippi.

keyEvents.title: Name written in the book of life
keyEvents.description: Paul confirms that Clement, together with other fellow workers, has his name written in the book of life, which testifies to his faith and service.
